Yeremy Pino had several attempts blocked or ruled offside as the Iraqi defense, led by Rebin Sulaka (who received a yellow card in the 80th minute), remained compact. In the dying moments of the game, Spain pushed forward with corner deliveries from Sergio Gomez , but the Iraqi backline held firm. Despite Spain playing the more attractive football, the match eventually ended in a draw, reflecting Iraq's defensive discipline and ability to capitalize on their limited chances.
